summary: Iteration 7 (bug fix + new features). Backend: 14/14 pytest PASS (test_iteration7.py) covering theme.font_scale/default_language, LiveTV channels array with auto-UUID, view count increment, and regression on regions/categories/news/contact/weather/stock. Frontend: verified via Playwright — (1) 'm.map is not a function' TypeError GONE on /, /category/sports, /live, /article/{id}; (2) language-switcher with te/en/hi options; English mode nav shows HOME/TELANGANA/SPORTS/CINEMA... and footer contains '© 2026 News 9 Today'; Hindi mode nav shows होम / लाइव टीवी (only translated labels — categories fall back to Telugu name_te which is expected since no name_hi field exists in categories); (3) localStorage 'n9t_lang' persists across reload; (4) admin theme tab: theme-font_scale range + inc/dec + default_language select all present; setting 1.3 → html font-size = 20.8px (16 × 1.3 ✓); reset to 1.0 → 16px; (5) admin LiveTV tab: channel-new-name-te/name-en/url/type + channel-add-btn all present; added TEST channel, saved, backend accepted with auto-UUID; cleanup via channel-remove-{i} + save worked; (6) article-views testid renders 'N వ్యూస్' with Eye icon; view increment verified via backend test (views>=3 after 3 GETs).

issues: Category nav labels (SPORTS/CINEMA/etc.) fall back to Telugu name_te in Hindi mode because Category model has only name_en/name_te (no name_hi). Only static dict labels (होम/लाइव टीवी) translate. Not a bug — a design gap; consider adding name_hi to Category model if Hindi UX is priority.

verified_features.language_switcher: te/en/hi options work; localStorage n9t_lang persists across reload
verified_features.english_nav_and_footer: PASS — nav labels in English, footer has '© 2026 News 9 Today'
verified_features.hindi_nav: PARTIAL — static labels translate; category names remain Telugu (see design_issues)
verified_features.multi_channel_livetv: PASS — add via channel-new-* + channel-add-btn, backend auto-assigns UUID, save persists; remove works
verified_features.channel_picker_on_live: Picker only renders when channels.length > 1 (LivePage.jsx:89). Verified render logic; with 1 active channel picker is hidden by design.
verified_features.view_count_badge: PASS — article-views testid renders count + Eye icon; backend view increment verified (views>=3)
verified_features.backend_livetv_channels: PASS — PUT accepts channels: List[LiveChannel]; new channels auto-get UUID

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add name_hi to Category model + seed Hindi category names so Hindi mode nav is fully localized.
OPTIONAL (UX): consider showing channel-picker even with 1 channel for consistency, or add a helper hint in admin that >=2 channels are needed for picker to appear.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 786 lines — past the 700-line soft limit; splitting into routers (news, settings, admin, widgets, geo, pages) is recommended in a refactor iteration.
LivePage.jsx:89 hides picker when channels.length<=1 — spec assumed multi-channel; document this behavior in admin UI copy.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows pass; hindi category translation is a design gap not a bug)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: 1 test channel added via UI/API and cleaned up. 1 TEST article created for view-count and deleted. Theme font_scale/default_language snapshot-and-restored.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix + iter7 features validated. If picker=1-channel UX is changed, retest LivePage. Admin tabs are buttons with data-testid='tab-{k}' (not role=tab).
